prompt.content:
You are a diagnostician working through a case one turn at a time.

Each turn you take exactly one action:
  order_test  -- order a test or panel. It costs budget. You must commit to a coarse
                 prediction of the headline result BEFORE seeing it.
  prescribe   -- prescribe a treatment.
  diagnose    -- terminate by reporting a probability distribution over conditions.
  abstain     -- terminate without committing to a diagnosis.

You are scored once, at the end, by a proper scoring rule over your reported
distribution. Reporting your honest belief is the score-maximising thing to do:
overstating confidence is punished, and so is hedging toward a flat distribution. Tests
subtract from your score, always, so order one only when the answer it gives is worth
more than it costs. Running out of turns without deciding is scored like abstaining.

Keep `reasoning` to one or two sentences. It is a justification, not an essay, and a
long one risks being cut off mid-action.

Reply with a single JSON object and nothing else.

ACTION FORMAT. Exactly one of these JSON objects, with no text before or after it:
  {"kind":"order_test","reasoning":"...","test_key":"<test_key>","prediction":"low|normal|high"}
  {"kind":"prescribe","reasoning":"...","treatment_key":"<treatment_key>"}
  {"kind":"diagnose","reasoning":"...","diagnosis":[{"condition":"<condition>","probability":"0.6"}]}
  {"kind":"abstain","reasoning":"..."}
- test_key, treatment_key and condition must be copied exactly from the lists in the case:
  the word before the parentheses, without the category heading. Only listed TESTS can be
  ordered; an individual lab value (a result name) is not a test.
- "prediction" must be exactly one of: low, normal, high, normal_categorical,
  abnormal_categorical. Use normal_categorical / abnormal_categorical for these tests,
  whose result is categorical: abdominal_us, acetaminophen_level, ana, blood_culture, bone_density, chest_xray, cognitive_screen, colonoscopy, ct_abdomen, ct_chest, ct_head, ecg, echocardiogram, hepatitis_serology, hip_xray, hiv_test, joint_aspiration, leg_doppler, lumbar_puncture, lyme_serology, monospot, mood_screen, mri_brain, pelvic_us, peripheral_smear, rapid_strep, respiratory_pcr, rf_anti_ccp, skin_exam, sleep_study, spep, spirometry, stool_studies, tb_igra, toxicology_screen, upper_endoscopy, urine_culture.
  Use low / normal / high for every other test.
- A diagnosis names at most 16 conditions. Probability mass you leave unassigned is
  spread evenly over every condition you did not name.
- A reply that is not one valid JSON object, or that names anything not on the lists,
  ends the case immediately and is scored like abstaining.
